subject: general
question: Which of the following nations/monarchies was a part of the coalition called ‘Central Powers’ in World War I?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Austria-Hungary**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **One of the two **main **coalitions **that fought in **World War I **was the **Central Powers (1914–18).**
 
• It was also **known **as the **Quadruple Alliance **and **included **the **German Empire**, **Austria-Hungary**, **the Ottoman Empire**, and the **Kingdom of Bulgaria**.
 
• **German New Guinea **and **German East Africa **were **two colonies **of these **nations **that **fought alongside **the **Central Powers **until practically all of their **colonies **were conquered by **the Allies**.
 
• The **Allied Powers **that had **united behind **the **Triple **Entente **confronted **and **destroyed **the **Central Powers**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The First World War**, also known as **World War I**.
 
• The **massive global **conflict lasted from **July 28, 1914**, until November **11, 1918**.
 
• It was **one of the bloodiest wars **in history **thanks **to new **technology**, including the **recent creation **of the **airplane**, **trench warfare**, and particularly **chemical weapons**.
 
• An estimated **9 million soldiers perished **in **battle**, and an **additional 5 million civilians perished through famine**, **sickness**, and **military activity**.
